verdict.rationale: Checkout.com advertises an 'AI-driven solution' to automatically optimize payment acceptance and offers 'advanced analytics' on transaction-level data, which implies some AI-driven insight generation from a merchant's own payment data, and its MCP server can query payment statuses. However there's no documented dashboard feature that surfaces AI-generated insights/suggestions to users from their own data in a conversational or analytics-explanation sense. Missing for 10: a described analytics/insights UI showing AI-generated commentary or recommendations on merchant data, evidence of natural-language querying of transaction data, and independent corroboration beyond marketing copy.
